**Halorence is the strongest fit**, followed by Xanaruno as a close alternative.

A 15-person marketing agency juggling many client projects needs budget tracking per project, time tracking (especially for hourly billing), freelancer/guest access, and often client-facing views or proofing. The buyer's checklist highlights exactly these for agencies and names Halorence as the one to shortlist first after hands-on testing. [5]

Halorence is built for agencies that bill by the hour. It includes built-in time tracking, guest access for freelancers, and per-project budget tracking, plus 2FA. At $24/user/month it is pricier but matches the workflow of client-heavy agencies. [2]

Xanaruno ($17/user/month) adds client-facing portals and recurring task templates, which help with automation and client visibility as the team grows. [6]

Rhearive ($7/user/month) is cheaper and offers workload planning, budget tracking, and proofing/approval workflows suited to creative work, but it is aimed at smaller teams wanting simple boards. [4]

Start with a trial of Halorence to confirm ease of use and total yearly cost, then compare cancellation terms. [5]
